blackboardUpdates.title: Two-city summary
blackboardUpdates.content: Edmonton, the provincial capital, has approximately 1,010,899 residents as of 2024, making it the second-largest city in Alberta. Calgary, the largest city, has approximately 1,396,000 residents in the same period. Both cities are economic hubs of the Prairie region; Calgary anchors the energy sector while Edmonton serves as the seat of government and a major centre for petroleum refining, advanced research, and post-secondary education. Combined, their populations make up the majority of Alberta's urban concentration.
